item.title: Rajasthan Factory Blaze Kills 7; Two Feared Trapped in Debris, Investigation On

item.title: Mumbai Mulund Metro Collapse: Family Refuses Body, Demands ₹2 Crore Compensation and Government Job
item.description: After Mulund metro parapet killed Ramdhani Yadav, family refuses body, demands ₹2 crore, government job.

item.title: Pramod Bhagat’s Historic Double: 6th SL3 World Title and Doubles Gold Cement India’s Para Badminton Supremacy
item.description: India’s para badminton star Pramod Bhagat made history with his sixth singles world title and doubles gold.

item.title: CBSE Class 10 & 12 Exams 2026: Essential Do’s and Don’ts Every Student Must Follow
item.description: CBSE outlines strict 2026 exam-day rules, including arrival time, attire, prohibited items, and preparation tips.

item.title: Odisha, Bhubaneswar Rooftop Blast: History-Sheeter Mother Die After Alleged Crude Bomb Explosion; NIA Probes Wider Conspiracy
item.description: Two people died and two were critically injured after a crude bomb allegedly exploded during assembly on a residential rooftop in Bhubaneswar’s Sundarpada, prompting an NIA investigation into possible wider links.

item.title: Logical Take | Blindfolded, Not Bought: When Justice in India Comes with a Price Tag
item.description: With 75% undertrials, 111th civil justice rank, and only 15 judges per million people, India’s legal delays reveal deep economic inequality in access to justice.

item.title: 13 Challans, No Licence, One Life Lost: Teen Gets Bail After SUV Allegedly Kills 23-Year-Old in Delhi
item.description: A 17-year-old was granted interim bail for board exams after allegedly driving an SUV without a licence and fatally hitting 23-year-old Sahil Dhaneshra in Dwarka, Delhi.

item.title: UP: After 7 Pheras, Midnight Revelation Halts Barabanki Wedding; Baraat Returns Without Bride
item.description: Barabanki wedding was called off after rituals when groom’s alleged transgender association led to police mediation.

item.title: Bihar: Massive Fire Destroys 500+ Shops in Katihar’s 70-Year-Old Kursela Market, No Casualties Reported
item.description: A suspected cylinder blast triggered a catastrophic blaze that wiped out hundreds of shops in Bihar’s historic Kursela Market, prompting protests and compensation demands.

item.title: Posters, Patrols and Precautions: High Alert in J&K’s Kathua and Samba After Intel Warns of 5 JeM Terrorists
item.description: Security forces have intensified border surveillance, imposed movement restrictions and sought public cooperation following credible intelligence of a possible infiltration attempt in Jammu’s border districts.
